<thought>Search the template catalog for any templates that break an aliphatic hydroxyl group (ignoring the formed group) with a larger result set, then we can identify one whose product contains a halogen (Cl, Br, I, or F). This will give the desired substitution template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "limit": 50
}
</action_input>
